title: THE ONE WHO COULD NOT SEE ANYTHING STAY
deck: A visitor that perceives only difference is answering a relay station with ever larger surges, and the captain's purge date is twelve days away. Illuminara cannot shield nine hundred people from a hello, so she writes the test down first and then sits very still.
shape: Six scenes across nineteen hours and an afterword: a hello that grows with every reply, a test written down with the captain's line in her own hand, an echo that fails for a reason, a corridor of people doing the same small thing again and again, a second test written before it is run, and a rota left in ordinary hands.

scenes.title: Answer for Answer
paragraphs: *The control ring, Anselm Deep Relay · the fourth day of the surges, 06:10*

Something had come down the beam four days ago and had been answering the station ever since. The lights on Deck Four went out in a pattern. Illuminara had noticed within an hour of coming aboard that it was not dark and bright at random but out, out-and-a-half, out: a stutter with a shape, as though the dark were being said.

Captain Dara Oyelaran watched from the ring with her arms folded and a cup she had stopped drinking from. Below them a pressure door shuddered in its frame, and Illuminara, without deciding to, steadied it.
The door went quiet. Eight seconds later the relay beam answered, louder than before, and all of Deck Four went black.
Ilse Karamat had the traces on the ring wall before the lights came back. She was the relay engineer, sixty and unhurried, with a pencil behind her ear for the things she did not trust screens with.

**Karamat**  
Forty milliseconds after every change on this station, the beam answers. A light, a valve, a door. It answers all of them, and each answer is a third bigger than the thing it answers.

**Oyelaran**  
A third bigger every time. That is not a hello. That is a fire with good manners.

**Illuminara**  
It is answering. That is the only thing it is doing. And I have just handed it something to answer.

**Karamat**  
The door.

**Illuminara**  
Deck Four was quiet until I touched it. Then it was the darkest it has been.
Oyelaran set the cup down and did not look at either of them.

**Oyelaran**  
The company's order is in my desk with a date on it. Day twelve, reserve permitting, I fire the beam purge, and whatever is in that beam almost certainly dies of it. Nine hundred people sleep on this station. Tell me which part of its hello I am supposed to survive.

**Illuminara**  
None of it, if it keeps growing. I am not asking you to survive it. I am asking for the days between now and your date, and I will tell you what I mean to do with them before I spend a single hour.
*Everything I can do is a change,* she thought. *And it has never met anything that was not.*

scenes.title: A Segment and a Line
paragraphs: *Karamat's bench, Deck Nine · 11:40*
Karamat's bench had been a dinner table once and still carried the ring of somebody's pot. She cleared a space for a sheet of paper.

**Karamat**  
So it answers change with change. Tell me what you can offer a thing like that that is not more change.

**Illuminara**  
Sameness. It has no word for it, because it has never met any. Imagine meeting only doors that open. What would you make of one that stayed shut?

**Karamat**  
Nothing. No difference, no signal. It would not see a thing that stays, and that is your problem before you begin.
Illuminara had been waiting for that objection, and was glad it came from someone who would not let her skip it.

**Illuminara**  
It does not see a thing that stays. It sees what does not move when it does. Every surge is the visitor shaking the world to find out what shakes. A wall is the part that did not. So whatever I give it has to be shaken, and has to hold.

**Karamat**  
Held through its own surges. A tone off the generator would sag on every one.

**Illuminara**  
Then we find that out on paper first. I want it written down before anyone measures: what counts as an answer, and what counts as nothing.

Karamat wrote. Segment R-7, an empty pressure corridor with its own tap on the beam, would carry the held thing. R-9, the same length, the same lights and no tone, would carry nothing. Success was R-7's surge peaks a third under R-9's, three hours running. Failure was no such gap by hour twelve. The captain would read the reserve board aloud on the hour, for the margin. She turned the sheet around, and Oyelaran, who had come in without a sound, read it standing.

**Oyelaran**  
And the third line.

**Karamat**  
Yours.

Oyelaran took the pencil. Under the sheet's last line she wrote: *Reserve at thirty-one percent or below, I fire the purge, because thirty-one is what the purge needs to fire. No discussion. D.O.* The reserve read forty-seven.

**Illuminara**  
I will not ask you to move that line.

**Oyelaran**  
Good. I should have liked you less if you had.
Half the station wanted the thing gone. The other half had begun, in the night hours, to say that the surges felt like someone knocking, and Oyelaran did not say which half she stood with.

scenes.title: The Echo That Sagged
paragraphs: *Relay corridor R-7 · hour three of the test*

The generator's tone was clean and low and entirely uninteresting, which was the point. Karamat read out the first three hours from a laptop on a milk crate, as if reading softly would make them kinder.

**Karamat**  
R-7 peaks are down eleven percent. R-9 peaks are down nine. That is noise. That is two noises shaking hands.

**Oyelaran**  
The reserve is thirty-eight; it was forty-seven this morning. At that rate I reach my line before your corridor reaches anything. Tell me this is not a failure.

**Karamat**  
I will tell you it is a failure with a reason. Look at the supply line. Each time it surges, the generator's voltage dips four-tenths of a percent. The tone sags when it shakes the world. To the visitor, the tone is not a wall. It is another voice, a quieter one, answering back.

**Illuminara**  
So we gave it an echo and called it a constant.

**Karamat**  
Nothing on this station will not sag when it pushes. It is all the same supply.
Illuminara looked down R-7, bare and cold under a single strip of light, and understood what she was being asked to be before anyone said it.

**Illuminara**  
Then I will be what does not sag. No window, no hand on the doors, no power anywhere in this corridor. Put every pressure door on manual and a person at each. Whatever it shakes, I will not shake back.

**Oyelaran**  
For how long?

**Illuminara**  
Until it stops needing to ask. I do not know how long that is. I know you will tell me when your line says stop.

**Karamat**  
And the reserve? The coils that damp the surges draw on it, and the draw follows the surges, how often and how big. Make them rarer and it stops falling by itself.

**Oyelaran**  
By itself. I will not run my line on 'by itself.' I read the board on the hour and the board decides, not the sheet. And you will not sit alone. Nobody holds anything alone on my station. Karamat, I want shifts.

Illuminara sat on the corridor floor with her back to the wall and her hands flat on her knees. She chose the place and the posture the way one chooses a word that will be said many times: so that it would be the same on the thousandth saying.

scenes.title: Same Again
paragraphs: *R-7, hour nine · the night shift*

By the ninth hour the corridor had become a small, patient country. Every hour a different member of the crew sat down in the same place beside Illuminara, put one hand flat on one knee as she did, and said nothing. Eleven people on the station refused the rota, and nobody pressed them.
Every hour, too, at the same minute, Bao Tran came down from the galley with a cup of tea and set it on the same square of deck.

**Bao**  
Sixty-one degrees. I keep a thermometer in my apron. It is an insult to the tea.

**Karamat**  
It answers, Bao. It will knock your cup over along with the lights.

**Bao**  
Then it knocks it over at sixty-one degrees. The cup is the cup.

The surges came, and the strip light stuttered, and the cup stayed where it was and as hot as it was. No one in the corridor moved. Illuminara noticed that for the first time in four days the station was simple: not quiet, but the same. A person sat down, the light shook, the person was still there. *Same again.*

In the long hours she tried to be the visitor for a moment: a mind in which nothing had ever been, only become, a world of kicks in the dark and the echoes of kicks. Its only word was *again*, and *bigger*, and *please*. She felt something close to tenderness for it, and held very still around the feeling so that it would not become a change.

Between two surges there was a space that had not been there at hour three. It was lengthening. It was the first rest the thing had ever made. The reserve, read aloud on the hour in the captain's flat voice, said thirty-four, and then thirty-four again.

At the tenth hour the handoff went wrong. The day sitter stood to stretch before the night sitter had sat, and for forty seconds the place beside Illuminara was empty. The beam answered with a surge a tenth larger than anything in two hours.

**Karamat**  
Eight percent over trend. That is a handoff.
Tomasz Reyes, the dock foreman, was next on the rota. He had put his name down to see for himself what he was refusing, and he had wanted the purge fired since the second night.

**Reyes**  
That was forty seconds of nobody. Twenty years on the cranes, you never lift the old chain until the new one is hooked. New one sits first. Hand on the same knee, both of you, count of ten, and then the old one goes.
They tried it at eleven and again at twelve, with different people each time, and Karamat, watching the scope, said nothing until the second one was over.

**Karamat**  
No bump at the changeover. Not one I can see.
At the twelfth hour she put her pencil down.

**Karamat**  
R-7 peaks are thirty-six percent under R-9, three hours running, and they held through two changes of sitter. By the sheet we wrote, that passes.

**Oyelaran**  
The reserve is thirty-three.

**Illuminara**  
Then the sheet was the first question, not the last. It does not say whether the visitor knows we are asking, or only likes this room. Write the second one now, before we know anything.

Karamat wrote it on the back of the first. A note of the visitor's own would count if it appeared in R-9, which nobody had touched; sat more than five hundredths off any tone they had played; and held through a disturbance the captain chose. The disturbance would draw one answering surge, and that one was allowed. A second surge after the note had held, bigger or the same, would not be allowed. Anything else was an echo or a mirror, and the log would say so.
Oyelaran wrote the disturbance on a card, folded it once, and put it in her breast pocket.

**Oyelaran**  
Nobody knows what is on it. Including you, Ilse. Seven hours. Reserve thirty-three, line thirty-one. If I read thirty-one on any hour, I fire, and your sheet can finish without me.

**Illuminara**  
Keep it.

scenes.title: Held Through
paragraphs: *R-7 and the galley, Anselm Deep · hours thirteen to nineteen*
At the thirteenth hour Karamat stood in front of Illuminara until she looked up.

**Karamat**  
Out. Three hours. If it is only you holding, then forty names on a rota is a ceremony, and I would sooner learn that now than at the end.
Illuminara had expected two. She did not argue for the shorter time; a result that held for three would be harder to call luck.

Standing was harder than any door Illuminara had held. She sat in the galley with a cold cup before a wall screen that showed the strip light of R-7, and she did not go back. Reyes had her place. She watched the light shake and a stranger's hand sit flat on a stranger's knee.

**Oyelaran**  
Thirty-three.

The captain's voice came over the galley speaker on the hour: thirty-three at the fourteenth, thirty-three at the fifteenth, flat now, and Karamat added that the cells were refilling between surges. At the sixteenth, the third hour of her absence, the captain read the gap against the sheet, to nobody in particular.

**Oyelaran**  
Peaks thirty-four under, with Illuminara out of the room.

Illuminara put her face in her hands, glad and a little bereft in the same breath. When the third hour ended Karamat came to the galley door and said she could go back, and Illuminara walked to R-7 and stood at its door without sitting. Reyes kept her place.

At the seventeenth hour Bao dropped the tray. The cup went across the deck and the strip light shook, and the beam answered once, small, and was finished in two seconds where the first answers had taken forty. Nobody in R-7 breathed until it was done. The speaker gave the reserve at thirty-four: the first point it had climbed.
At the nineteenth hour, in R-9, where nobody sat and no tone had ever been held, there was a sound.
Karamat ran to the second tap. It was a single note, low and even, in a corridor that had never been given one.

**Karamat**  
It is not ours. Ours is a hair above. This is eleven hundredths off. A mirror would be on ours.

**Illuminara**  
A mirror would stop when we stopped. We have not touched R-9.
Oyelaran took the card from her breast pocket and read it as though it were news.

**Oyelaran**  
Lights. R-9. Ten seconds.

Karamat killed them. The dark was total and sudden, and the beam surged once in the old way, enormous, and the note did not move. It sat in the dark like a coal. The lights returned and it was still there, and the second surge that should have followed never came.

**Karamat**  
Untouched segment. Eleven hundredths off. Held through the dark. One surge, the one the dark was bound to draw, and no second after it. That is all four lines of the sheet, in the order we wrote them.
Oyelaran stood with her hand on the corridor wall as though it were the hull.

**Oyelaran**  
Thirty-five. The lowest I read in nineteen hours was thirty-three, and my line never moved. Write that down, Ilse, in ink. I will not tell you this is safe. It is one note in an empty corridor. The purge stays charged and I stay at the board. If it grows again I will fire, and I will not apologise to it.

**Illuminara**  
Keep it. I do not know what the note means. I know it kept it when nobody asked and held it when we tried to shake it. For something that has never had a thing, that is a great deal to hold.
For a moment the note in R-9 and the cup in R-7 were the only two constant things on Anselm Deep, and one of them belonged to the visitor.

scenes.title: Weather
paragraphs: *The relay hall, Anselm Deep · eleven days later, 15:20*

The reserve stood at seventy-nine percent. Ore freight crossed the beam from both mining systems on schedule, and Deck Four had slept through the night for the first time in a fortnight. The purge stayed charged at the captain's order, with her line still pencilled on the board.

The thing in the beam had moods. On the fourth afternoon after the test the lights stuttered for no reason anyone could name, and the crew who had never sat in R-7 looked up. Bao put the cup down in its square. The tone rose, wavered, and found its place.

**Karamat**  
Weather. It will be weather for as long as it is here.

**Oyelaran**  
Then the station keeps an umbrella.

She meant the rota. It was Karamat's now: a list on the galley wall, forty names, each signed for an hour of sitting, and above it, in dock marker, Reyes's rule about the changeover. Two of the names had wanted the purge. Reyes's was one.
Illuminara stood in the doorway with her bag. She had not used her power on the beam once since the third hour of the test, and she found that she did not miss it.

**Karamat**  
It held the afternoon you were in the galley. That is why I wrote forty.

**Illuminara**  
I was never the constant. I was where it started. It is yours now, all forty of you, and the tea.

**Bao**  
Sixty-one.
She laughed, and went out to the shuttle. Behind her the lights shook once, a long way off, and the note in the corridor held, and somewhere a cup was set down in the same place.

critic_line: Illuminara discovers that Flicker perceives only difference, then helps the station offer constancy without surrendering its safety line: Oyelaran keeps the purge charged, Reyes turns a failed handoff into a rule ordinary people can own, and Flicker freely makes and holds an off-frequency note through a precommitted disturbance; the result protects nine hundred people, restores the relay and leaves both visitor and crew changed without pretending the new neighbour is harmless.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1 exact 50/50 mean of genuine isolated GPT and Claude final reader judgments.
shared_strengths: A humane, idea-driven premise (answering a difference-only alien with constancy) with warm crew dialogue and a communal resolution. Heavy procedural detail, percentages and pre-registered test criteria may slow some readers, and the stylized title and opening are dense. Emotional payoff and small touches like the tea are memorable.

An elegant first-contact puzzle becomes a humane drama about restraint, shared labor, and learning to make room for difference. The dialogue is crisp, stakes stay tangible, and the cup/rota motifs pay off beautifully. The number-heavy protocols and repeated hourly readings may slow some readers, but the emotional and conceptual resolution is unusually memorable.

translation_sl.title: TISTI, KI NI MOGEL VIDETI, DA KARKOLI OSTANE
translation_sl.deck: Obiskovalec, ki zaznava samo razliko, relejni postaji odgovarja z vse večjimi sunki, kapitanov rok za čistilno sprožitev pa je čez dvanajst dni. Illuminara devetsto ljudi ne more zaščititi pred pozdravom, zato preizkus najprej zapiše, nato pa obmiruje.
translation_sl.shape: Šest prizorov v devetnajstih urah in sklep: pozdrav, ki z vsakim odgovorom raste, preizkus, zapisan s kapitanovo mejo v njeni lastni pisavi, odmev, ki odpove z razlogom, hodnik ljudi, ki vedno znova naredijo isto majhno stvar, drugi preizkus, zapisan pred izvedbo, ter razpored, prepuščen običajnim rokam.

scenes.title: Odgovor za odgovor
paragraphs: *Nadzorni obroč, globinski rele Anselm · četrti dan sunkov, 06:10*

Nekaj je pred štirimi dnevi prišlo po žarku in je odtlej odgovarjalo postaji. Luči na četrti palubi so ugašale v vzorcu. Illuminara je v eni uri po prihodu na krov opazila, da tema in svetloba nista naključni, temveč ugasnjeno, ugasnjeno-in-pol, ugasnjeno: jecljanje z obliko, kakor da bi tema govorila.

Kapitan Dara Oyelaran je opazovala z obroča s prekrižanimi rokami in skodelico, iz katere je nehala piti. Pod njima so se tlačna vrata tresla v okvirju in Illuminara jih je, ne da bi se za to odločila, umirila.
Vrata so utihnila. Osem sekund pozneje je relejni žarek odgovoril glasneje kot prej in vsa četrta paluba je potemnela.
Ilse Karamat je imela sledi na steni obroča, še preden so se luči vrnile. Bila je relejna inženirka, šestdesetletna in brez naglice, s svinčnikom za ušesom za stvari, ki jih ni zaupala zaslonom.

**Karamat**  
Štirideset milisekund po vsaki spremembi na tej postaji žarek odgovori. Luč, ventil, vrata. Odgovori na vse in vsak odgovor je za tretjino večji od stvari, na katero odgovarja.

**Oyelaran**  
Vsakič za tretjino večji. To ni pozdrav. To je ogenj z lepimi manirami.

**Illuminara**  
Odgovarja. To je edino, kar počne. In pravkar sem mu izročila nekaj, na kar lahko odgovori.

**Karamat**  
Vrata.

**Illuminara**  
Četrta paluba je bila tiha, dokler se je nisem dotaknila. Potem je bila najtemnejša doslej.
Oyelaran je odložila skodelico in ni pogledala nobene od njiju.

**Oyelaran**  
Ukaz družbe je v moji mizi in na njem je datum. Dvanajsti dan, če bo rezerva dopuščala, sprožim čiščenje žarka in karkoli je v njem, bo zaradi tega skoraj zagotovo umrlo. Na tej postaji spi devetsto ljudi. Povej mi, kateri del njegovega pozdrava naj bi preživela.

**Illuminara**  
Nobenega, če bo še naprej rasel. Ne prosim te, da ga preživiš. Prosim za dneve med zdaj in tvojim datumom, in preden porabim eno samo uro, ti bom povedala, kaj nameravam z njimi.
*Vse, kar lahko naredim, je sprememba,* je pomislila. *In ono še nikoli ni srečalo ničesar, kar ne bi bilo sprememba.*

scenes.title: Odsek in črta
paragraphs: *Karamatina delovna miza, deveta paluba · 11:40*
Karamatina delovna miza je bila nekoč jedilna in še vedno je nosila krog od nekogaršnjega lonca. Očistila je prostor za list papirja.

**Karamat**  
Torej na spremembo odgovori s spremembo. Povej mi, kaj lahko takemu bitju ponudiš, kar ni še več spremembe.

**Illuminara**  
Enakost. Zanjo nima besede, ker je še nikoli ni srečalo. Predstavljaj si, da srečuješ samo vrata, ki se odpirajo. Kaj bi si mislila o vratih, ki bi ostala zaprta?

**Karamat**  
Ničesar. Ni razlike, ni signala. Stvari, ki ostane, ne bi videlo, in to je tvoj problem, še preden začneš.
Illuminara je čakala na ta ugovor in bila vesela, da je prišel od nekoga, ki ji ga ne bo dovolil preskočiti.

**Illuminara**  
Ne vidi stvari, ki ostane. Vidi tisto, kar se ne premakne, ko se premakne ono. Vsak sunek je obiskovalec, ki trese svet, da bi ugotovil, kaj se strese. Stena je tisti del, ki se ni. Torej bo treba vse, kar mu dam, pretresti, in moralo bo zdržati.

**Karamat**  
Zdržati skozi njegove lastne sunke. Ton iz generatorja bi ob vsakem upadel.

**Illuminara**  
Potem to najprej ugotovimo na papirju. Želim, da je zapisano, preden kdo kaj izmeri: kaj šteje kot odgovor in kaj kot nič.

Karamat je pisala. Odsek R-7, prazen tlačni hodnik z lastnim odcepom z žarka, bo nosil tisto, kar ostaja. R-9, enako dolg, z enakimi lučmi in brez tona, ne bo nosil ničesar. Uspeh bo, če bodo vrhovi sunkov v R-7 tri ure zapored za tretjino nižji kot v R-9. Neuspeh bo, če do dvanajste ure take razlike ne bo. Kapitan bo vsako polno uro na glas prebrala stanje rezerv, da bodo poznali mejo. Obrnila je list in Oyelaran, ki je neslišno vstopila, ga je prebrala stoje.

**Oyelaran**  
In tretja vrstica.

**Karamat**  
Tvoja.

Oyelaran je vzela svinčnik. Pod zadnjo vrstico lista je zapisala: *Rezerva pri enaintridesetih odstotkih ali manj: sprožim čiščenje, ker je enaintrideset toliko, kolikor ga potrebuje za sprožitev. Brez razprave. D. O.* Rezerva je kazala sedeminštirideset.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom te prosila, da premakneš to mejo.

**Oyelaran**  
Dobro. Manj bi mi bila všeč, če bi me.
Pol postaje je hotelo, da stvar izgine. Druga polovica je v nočnih urah začela govoriti, da so sunki podobni trkanju, Oyelaran pa ni povedala, h kateri polovici spada.

scenes.title: Odmev, ki je upadel
paragraphs: *Relejni hodnik R-7 · tretja ura preizkusa*

Ton generatorja je bil čist, nizek in povsem nezanimiv, kar je bil njegov namen. Karamat je prve tri ure prebrala s prenosnika na zaboju za mleko, kakor da bodo številke prijaznejše, če jih bo brala tiho.

**Karamat**  
Vrhovi v R-7 so nižji za enajst odstotkov. V R-9 za devet. To je šum. To sta dva šuma, ki si segata v roke.

**Oyelaran**  
Rezerva je osemintrideset; zjutraj je bila sedeminštirideset. S takim tempom bom dosegla svojo mejo, preden bo tvoj hodnik dosegel karkoli. Povej mi, da to ni neuspeh.

**Karamat**  
Povedala ti bom, da je neuspeh z razlogom. Poglej napajalni vod. Ob vsakem sunku napetost generatorja pade za štiri desetinke odstotka. Ton upade, ko strese svet. Za obiskovalca ton ni stena. Je samo drug glas, tišji, ki odgovarja nazaj.

**Illuminara**  
Torej smo mu dali odmev in ga poimenovali stalnica.

**Karamat**  
Na tej postaji ni ničesar, kar ne bi upadlo, ko pritisne. Vse uporablja isto napajanje.
Illuminara je pogledala po R-7, golem in hladnem pod enim samim svetlobnim trakom, ter razumela, kaj mora postati, še preden je to kdo izrekel.

**Illuminara**  
Potem bom jaz tista, ki ne upade. Brez okna, brez roke na vratih, brez moči kjerkoli v tem hodniku. Vsa tlačna vrata prestavite na ročno upravljanje in k vsakim postavite človeka. Karkoli bo streslo, mu ne bom odgovorila s tresenjem.

**Oyelaran**  
Kako dolgo?

**Illuminara**  
Dokler mu ne bo več treba spraševati. Ne vem, koliko časa bo to. Vem, da mi boš povedala, kdaj tvoja meja zahteva konec.

**Karamat**  
In rezerva? Tuljave, ki dušijo sunke, jo porabljajo, poraba pa sledi sunkom, njihovi pogostosti in velikosti. Če bodo redkejši, bo rezerva sama nehala padati.

**Oyelaran**  
Sama. Svoje meje ne bom vodila na besedi »sama«. Stanje preberem vsako uro in odloča stanje, ne list. In ne boš sedela sama. Na moji postaji nihče ničesar ne drži sam. Karamat, hočem izmene.
Illuminara je sedla na tla hodnika s hrbtom ob steni in dlanmi plosko na kolenih. Mesto in držo je izbrala tako, kakor človek izbere besedo, ki jo bo velikokrat ponovil: da bo ob tisoči izreki enaka.

scenes.title: Spet enako
paragraphs: *R-7, deveta ura · nočna izmena*

Do devete ure je hodnik postal majhna, potrpežljiva dežela. Vsako uro je drug član posadke sedel na isto mesto poleg Illuminare, položil eno roko plosko na koleno, kakor ona, in molčal. Enajst ljudi na postaji je razpored zavrnilo in nihče jih ni silil.
Prav tako je vsako uro ob isti minuti Bao Tran prišel iz kuhinje s skodelico čaja in jo postavil na isti kvadrat palube.

**Bao**  
Enainšestdeset stopinj. V predpasniku imam termometer. To je žalitev za čaj.

**Karamat**  
Odgovarja, Bao. Skodelico ti bo prevrnilo skupaj z lučmi.

**Bao**  
Potem jo bo prevrnilo pri enainšestdesetih stopinjah. Skodelica je skodelica.

Sunki so prihajali, svetlobni trak je jecljal, skodelica pa je ostala tam, kjer je bila, in tako vroča, kot je bila. Nihče na hodniku se ni premaknil. Illuminara je opazila, da je bila postaja prvič v štirih dneh preprosta: ne tiha, temveč enaka. Človek je sedel, luč se je stresla, človek je bil še vedno tam. *Spet enako.*

V dolgih urah je za trenutek poskusila biti obiskovalec: um, v katerem nič nikoli ni bilo, vse je samo postajalo, svet udarcev v temi in njihovih odmevov. Njegova edina beseda je bila *spet* in *večje* in *prosim*. Do njega je začutila nekaj podobnega nežnosti in ob tem občutku ostala povsem pri miru, da ne bi postal sprememba.

Med dvema sunkoma je nastal prostor, ki ga ob tretji uri še ni bilo. Daljšal se je. To je bil prvi počitek, ki ga je stvar kdaj ustvarila. Rezerva, ki jo je kapitan vsako uro prebrala s ploskim glasom, je rekla štiriintrideset in nato znova štiriintrideset.

Ob deseti uri je predaja spodletela. Dnevni sedeči je vstal, da bi se pretegnil, še preden je nočni sedeči sedel, in mesto ob Illuminari je bilo štirideset sekund prazno. Žarek je odgovoril s sunkom, za desetino večjim od vseh v zadnjih dveh urah.

**Karamat**  
Osem odstotkov nad trendom. To je predaja.
Tomasz Reyes, pristaniški delovodja, je bil naslednji na razporedu. Vpisal se je, da bi sam videl, kaj zavrača, čistilno sprožitev pa je hotel že od druge noči.

**Reyes**  
Štirideset sekund ni bilo nikogar. Dvajset let sem na žerjavih: stare verige nikoli ne odklopiš, dokler ni vpeta nova. Najprej sede novi. Roko na isto koleno, oba, do deset preštejeta, nato stari odide.
Poskusili so ob enajstih in znova ob dvanajstih, vsakič z drugimi ljudmi, Karamat pa med opazovanjem zaslona ni rekla ničesar, dokler ni bil končan drugi poskus.

**Karamat**  
Ob menjavi ni bilo sunka. Niti takega, ki bi ga lahko videla.
Ob dvanajsti uri je odložila svinčnik.

**Karamat**  
Vrhovi v R-7 so tri ure zapored za šestintrideset odstotkov nižji kot v R-9 in zdržali so dve menjavi sedečega. Po listu, ki smo ga napisali, je to uspeh.

**Oyelaran**  
Rezerva je triintrideset.

**Illuminara**  
Potem je bil list prvo vprašanje, ne zadnje. Ne pove, ali obiskovalec ve, da ga sprašujemo, ali mu je samo všeč ta prostor. Napišite drugega zdaj, preden vemo karkoli.

Karamat ga je zapisala na hrbtno stran prvega. Ton, ki bi ga ustvaril obiskovalec sam, bo štel, če se pojavi v R-9, ki se ga ni nihče dotaknil; če bo več kot pet stotink oddaljen od kateregakoli tona, ki so ga predvajali; in če bo zdržal motnjo, ki jo izbere kapitan. Motnja bo sprožila en odgovorni sunek in ta bo dovoljen. Drugi sunek po tem, ko se bo ton ustalil, večji ali enak, ne bo dovoljen. Vse drugo bo odmev ali zrcalo in tako bo pisalo v dnevniku.
Oyelaran je motnjo napisala na kartico, jo enkrat prepognila in spravila v prsni žep.

**Oyelaran**  
Nihče ne ve, kaj je na njej. Tudi ti ne, Ilse. Sedem ur. Rezerva triintrideset, meja enaintrideset. Če ob kateri koli polni uri preberem enaintrideset, sprožim, vaš list pa lahko konča brez mene.

**Illuminara**  
Obdrži jo.

scenes.title: Vzdržalo je
paragraphs: *R-7 in kuhinja, Anselm Deep · od trinajste do devetnajste ure*
Ob trinajsti uri je Karamat stopila pred Illuminaro in tam stala, dokler ni dvignila pogleda.

**Karamat**  
Ven. Tri ure. Če držiš samo ti, potem je štirideset imen na razporedu obred, jaz pa bi to raje izvedela zdaj kot na koncu.
Illuminara je pričakovala dve. Ni se prepirala za krajši čas; rezultat, ki bi zdržal tri, bi bilo teže pripisati sreči.

Vstati je bilo teže kot držati katerakoli vrata. Illuminara je sedela v kuhinji s hladno skodelico pred stenskim zaslonom, ki je kazal svetlobni trak v R-7, in ni šla nazaj. Na njenem mestu je bil Reyes. Gledala je, kako se luč trese in tuja roka počiva plosko na tujem kolenu.

**Oyelaran**  
Triintrideset.

Kapitanov glas se je vsako polno uro oglasil iz kuhinjskega zvočnika: triintrideset ob štirinajsti, triintrideset ob petnajsti, zdaj nespremenjeno, Karamat pa je dodala, da se celice med sunki znova polnijo. Ob šestnajsti, v tretji uri njene odsotnosti, je kapitan prebrala razliko po listu, kakor da ne govori nikomur posebej.

**Oyelaran**  
Vrhovi štiriintrideset odstotkov nižji, Illuminare pa ni v prostoru.

Illuminara si je zakrila obraz z dlanmi, vesela in nekoliko oropana v istem dihu. Ko se je tretja ura iztekla, je Karamat prišla do vrat kuhinje in rekla, da se lahko vrne. Illuminara je odšla do R-7 in obstala pri vratih, ne da bi sedla. Reyes je ostal na njenem mestu.

Ob sedemnajsti uri je Bao spustil pladenj. Skodelica je zdrsela čez palubo, svetlobni trak se je stresel in žarek je odgovoril enkrat, šibko, ter končal v dveh sekundah, medtem ko so prvi odgovori trajali štirideset. Nihče v R-7 ni zadihal, dokler ni bilo konec. Zvočnik je sporočil rezervo štiriintrideset: prvič je narasla.
Ob devetnajsti uri se je v R-9, kjer nihče ni sedel in kjer ni nihče nikoli vzdrževal tona, zaslišal zvok.
Karamat je stekla k drugemu odcepu. Bil je en sam ton, nizek in enakomeren, v hodniku, ki mu ga nihče ni nikoli ponudil.

**Karamat**  
Ni naš. Naš je za las višji. Ta je oddaljen enajst stotink. Zrcalo bi bilo na naši frekvenci.

**Illuminara**  
Zrcalo bi se ustavilo, ko bi se ustavili mi. R-9 se nismo dotaknili.
Oyelaran je iz prsnega žepa vzela kartico in jo prebrala, kakor da bere novico.

**Oyelaran**  
Luči. R-9. Deset sekund.

Karamat jih je ugasnila. Tema je bila popolna in nenadna, žarek je enkrat sunil na stari način, silovito, ton pa se ni premaknil. Sedel je v temi kakor žerjavica. Luči so se vrnile, ton je bil še vedno tam, drugega sunka, ki bi moral slediti, pa ni bilo.

**Karamat**  
Nedotaknjeni odsek. Enajst stotink stran. Zdržal skozi temo. En sunek, tisti, ki ga je tema morala sprožiti, in za njim nobenega drugega. To so vse štiri vrstice lista, v vrstnem redu, v katerem smo jih zapisali.
Oyelaran je stala z roko na steni hodnika, kakor da bi bila ladijski trup.

**Oyelaran**  
Petintrideset. Najnižje, kar sem prebrala v devetnajstih urah, je bilo triintrideset, in moja meja se ni premaknila. Zapiši to, Ilse, s črnilom. Ne bom vam rekla, da je to varno. To je en ton v praznem hodniku. Čistilna sprožitev ostaja pripravljena, jaz pa ostajam pri nadzorni plošči. Če bo spet zraslo, bom sprožila in se mu ne bom opravičevala.

**Illuminara**  
Obdrži jo. Ne vem, kaj ton pomeni. Vem, da ga je ohranilo, ko ga ni nihče prosil, in da ga je zadržalo, ko smo ga skušali pretresti. Za nekaj, kar še nikoli ni imelo stvari, je to zelo veliko, kar lahko drži.
Za trenutek sta bila ton v R-9 in skodelica v R-7 edini stalni stvari na Anselm Deepu, ena od njiju pa je pripadala obiskovalcu.

scenes.title: Vreme
paragraphs: *Relejna dvorana, Anselm Deep · enajst dni pozneje, 15:20*

Rezerva je bila pri devetinsedemdesetih odstotkih. Tovor rude iz obeh rudarskih sistemov je po urniku prečkal žarek, četrta paluba pa je prvič v dveh tednih prespala noč. Čistilna sprožitev je po kapitanovem ukazu ostala pripravljena, njena meja pa je bila še vedno s svinčnikom zapisana na plošči.

Stvar v žarku je imela razpoloženja. Četrto popoldne po preizkusu so luči jecljale brez razloga, ki bi ga kdo znal poimenovati, in člani posadke, ki niso nikoli sedeli v R-7, so dvignili pogled. Bao je skodelico postavil na njen kvadrat. Ton se je dvignil, zanihal in našel svoje mesto.

**Karamat**  
Vreme. Vreme bo, dokler bo tukaj.

**Oyelaran**  
Potem postaja obdrži dežnik.

Mislila je razpored. Zdaj je bil Karamatin: seznam na steni kuhinje, štirideset imen, vsako podpisano za uro sedenja, nad njim pa z markerjem za pristanišče Reyesovo pravilo o menjavi. Dve imeni sta hoteli čistilno sprožitev. Reyesovo je bilo eno od njiju.
Illuminara je stala pri vratih s torbo. Od tretje ure preizkusa ni niti enkrat uporabila svoje moči na žarku in ugotovila je, da je ne pogreša.

**Karamat**  
Vzdržalo je tisto popoldne, ko si bila v kuhinji. Zato sem zapisala štirideset.

**Illuminara**  
Nikoli nisem bila stalnica. Bila sem kraj, kjer se je začelo. Zdaj je vaše, vseh štiridesetih, in čaja.

**Bao**  
Enainšestdeset.
Zasmejala se je in odšla do raketoplana. Za njo so se luči nekje daleč enkrat stresle, ton v hodniku je vzdržal in nekje je nekdo skodelico postavil na isto mesto.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara odkrije, da Flicker zaznava samo razliko, nato pa postaji pomaga ponuditi stalnost, ne da bi opustila svojo varnostno mejo: Oyelaran ohrani pripravljeno čistilno sprožitev, Reyes neuspešno predajo spremeni v pravilo, ki ga lahko prevzamejo običajni ljudje, Flicker pa svobodno ustvari in skozi vnaprej določeno motnjo ohrani ton zunaj frekvence; rezultat zaščiti devetsto ljudi, obnovi rele ter spremeni tako obiskovalca kot posadko, ne da bi se pretvarjal, da je novi sosed nenevaren.
